name: dire_maul_east
notes: Hand-written from the map-429 spawn census (2026-10-24). Every pull group is a spawn row's own creature_groups pack; no entry was invented.

Order and leg split follow the navmesh path lengths between pull centres, not straight lines. The generator skeleton mixed the courtyard (z -4), the south pods (z -25), the basin (z -52..-58), Lethtendris' balcony (z +16) and Alzzin's cave (z -120) inside every leg.

Leg 0 zevrim_thornhoof: the courtyard and the south pod field, then Zevrim (the Conservatory Door's gossip refuses until Zevrim is DONE). Leg 1 hydrospawn: the basin. Leg 2 lethtendris: her balcony. Leg 3 alzzin_the_wildshaper: the cave descent and the cave.

The Conservatory Door (176907 at 131.286 -278.89 -56.5211) blocks the way to Alzzin and opens only through Old Ironbark's gossip (npc_ecorcefer, after Zevrim). The plan has no gossip step: the operator opens it, or a later plan adds gossip + wait_for.

Seven basin packs are leg 0's last pulls before Zevrim (the imps and Hellcaller at -70 -444, the rogues at -86 -463, the lashers at -31 -467, the imps at -8 -456, the Fel Lash at 50 -454, the Shadowstalker at 86 -450 and the trio at 70 -428): the navmesh route from the courtyard to Zevrim descends the spiral through the basin, so a live pack there would be met on the walk. Leg 1 keeps the rest of the basin.

Not planned: Pusillin 14354 (friendly until the chase; drops the Crescent Key), Old Ironbark 11491 (the door's gossip NPC), Isalien 16097 (summoned at her brazier; the trigger 16045 is a civilian trigger), Pimgib 14349 (Lethtendris' pet: her boss row's first).
